intentionalContact: Bridge feet embedded in the bank are intentional abutment contact; overlap with bank volume is not a failure.

channel.method: Exact bridge and transition triangle raycasts along 120 segments following riverCenter(z), each direction, at five lateral offsets and three requested heights. Finite samples do not certify untested coordinates.

deck.method: Topmost bridge and meadow triangle raycast along x at bridge center z, spacing <= 0.02 m. A supported deck crossing of bank height 2.22 must exist at both banks; bank, deck and explicitly named transition union must have no gaps or sampled step over 0.15 m.
